_comment: The recorded picks and turns (onprem profile, Qwen3.8-Flash-Next Q2_0 on Strata in Giang's home lab, thinking off, 2026-11-16; NOT attested): sales.skill_pick@1.0.0 picked thread-intents@1.0.0 for all 80 messages (confidence p50 0.98, min 0.70; one below the 0.9 floor, read by the one call), then sales.dw1_agent@1.1.0 read with DW1's conduct and the skill's words in its prompt. 0.75 of the 80 golden thread messages read as exactly their intents (0.80 of the bar's 60; the bar is 0.85, the one call 0.796, the thread agent 0.85; the free choice of 1.0.0 read 0.183). 3.09 model calls per message (one pick, 2.1 turn calls), 90 look-ups in 80 turns, 3 turns at the five-call ceiling (63 before); p50 4.4 s, p95 6.1 s per message.
